description: This file defines the RestRequest class within the JiraApi namespace; it provides methods to make REST API calls (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to Jira, handle request building, and manage cURL options.

classes.name: RestRequest
classes.description: Class encapsulating functionality to perform REST API requests to Jira, including setting up request details, executing the request, and handling response data.

methods.name: openConnect
methods.description: Initializes connection parameters including URL, HTTP verb, request body or file, and content type.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Resets the request state and response data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request based on the specified verb, managing cURL session and error handling.

methods.name: buildPostBody
methods.description: Constructs the POST request body, handling file uploads or JSON encoding.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Returns the response payload from the server.

methods.name: getResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the HTTP response.

methods.name: lastRequestStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the last request was successful (HTTP status code 2xx).

methods.name: executePost
methods.description: Executes a POST request with request body data.

methods.name: executePut
methods.description: Executes a PUT request with request body data.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Performs the cURL execution and captures response and info.

methods.name: setCurlOpts
methods.description: Configures cURL options including timeouts, headers, proxy, and SSL settings.

methods.name: setAuth
methods.description: Sets basic authentication credentials for the request if available.
